target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures define Assets Under Supervision (AUS), listing included assets (institutional, third-party distributed, high-net-worth, mutual/hedge/credit/private equity/real estate funds, separately managed accounts, private bank deposits, advisory relationships) and excluded assets (self-directed brokerage).

Both disclosures provide details on total wealth management client assets, AUS trends/changes (inflows/market appreciation), and descriptions of non-fee-earning alternative assets. The 2023 disclosure includes specific tables/footnotes on uncalled capital and equity securities; the 2024 disclosure notes the $325B increase and total assets of $1.6T.

previous_disclosures.section: Results of Operations > Asset & Wealth Management > THE GOLDMAN SACHS GROUP, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES
previous_disclosures.summary: Assets Under Supervision (AUS) includes institutional clients' assets, assets sourced through third-party distributors, and high-net-worth clients' assets where the firm earns a fee for managing assets on a discretionary basis, including mutual funds, hedge funds, credit funds, private equity funds, real estate funds, and separately managed accounts. It also includes client assets invested with third-party managers, private bank deposits, and advisory relationships where the firm earns fees but does not have investment discretion, excluding self-directed brokerage assets. Liquidity products include money market funds and private bank deposits. Direct strategies primarily include private equity, growth equity, private credit, liquid alternatives, and real estate strategies. Alternative assets included $58 billion in uncalled capital as of December 2023. Non-fee-earning alternative assets primarily consist of balance sheet investments, unfunded commitments, and direct investing strategies like private equity and real estate. Equity securities included $12.1 billion in private equity positions and $1.1 billion in public equity positions (converted from private equity) as of December 2023.
